article-meta.article-title: Archival Dispatch: 14 Master Broadcasts Dated Across Voices of History, Count Basie Remotes, The Dan Smoot Report, and Guests of Doom
article-meta.kwd-group: Voices of History, Apollo 11, Neil Armstrong, John J Pershing, Graham McNamee, Billy Sunday, George Bernard Shaw, Count Basie, Big Band Remotes, Dan Smoot Report, Guests of Doom, Original Filenames

sec.title: Batch 69 Forensic Discoveries
sec.p: Batch 69 recovers and dates 14 historical broadcasts spanning momentous 20th-century audio archives, swing ballroom dance remotes, Cold War political broadcasts, and mystery serials: 6 iconic audio documents from ***Voices of History*** (including General John J. Pershing addressing the American public from France in 1918, Graham McNamee covering Charles Lindbergh's hero return in 1927, evangelist Billy Sunday's 1929 temperance sermon, George Bernard Shaw's 1937 pacifist broadcast, and the historic 1969 Apollo 11 Lunar Landing audio with Neil Armstrong), 4 live ballroom broadcasts on ***Big Band Remotes*** (Count Basie live at the Avadon Ballroom, Blue Barron at Hotel Lincoln, Ralph Flanagan on KFI, and AFRS Magic Carpet), 2 political broadcasts from ***The Dan Smoot Report*** (1964–1965), and 2 chapters of the suspense thriller ***Guests of Doom*** (1948).
